WITH per_currency AS (
  SELECT
    feecoin,
    AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate,
    AVG((rebrate - feerate) / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_relative_gap
  FROM fees
  GROUP BY feecoin
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rebate) AS cross_currency_avg_rebate
  FROM per_currency
),
above_benchmark AS (
  SELECT
    pc.avg_rebate,
    pc.avg_relative_gap,
    pc.avg_rebate - b.cross_currency_avg_rebate AS excess_rebate
  FROM per_currency pc
  CROSS JOIN benchmark b
  WHERE b.cross_currency_avg_rebate IS NOT NULL
    AND pc.avg_rebate > b.cross_currency_avg_rebate
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_rebate) AS mean_average_maker_rebate,
  AVG(avg_relative_gap) AS mean_average_relative_gap,
  AVG(excess_rebate) AS mean_excess_over_cross_currency_benchmark
FROM above_benchmark;
